title: Scheduled irrigation source concentration carrier

equations: the scheduled irrigation input parser accepts cirrs in [0,100] M/L3 when solute input is enabled
on the scheduled task-3 path, cirr is assigned cirrs before the event-selection and amount logic
the scheduled result exposes that concentration as a source descriptor without calculating or booking solute mass

scope: add a finite scheduled concentration parameter with the B1 input range
carry it unchanged through the scheduled typed irrigation result
100000 deterministic events with varied single SSDI source nodes and unchanged water-source checks
verify zero-default backward behavior and invalid concentration rejection
non_goals: file parsing, solute switch ownership, fixed irrigation concentration parsing or event calendar
solute mass integration, transport, accepted Richards flux, restart or production admission
changing scheduled water depth, rate, duration, selected node or source-vector amount
pass_conditions: scheduled concentration is bitwise preserved for each completed event
zero default remains unchanged and nonfinite/out-of-range values fail closed
100000 deterministic events pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
SSDI water vector and offered amount remain unchanged
